const Ctx = opaque {};

export fn zc_write(
    ctx: *Ctx,
    // where the payload comes from
    data: [*]const u8,

    len: usize,
    out: *u64,
) callconv(.c) usize {
    _ = ctx;
    _ = data;
    _ = len;
    _ = out;
    return 0;
}

export fn zc_open(
    path: [*:0]const u8,
    scratch: [*]u8,
    written: ?*usize,
    ratio: f64,
    strict: bool,
    c_int,
) void {}
